content: {"pricing_strategy":{"summary":"OpenAI pricing depends heavily on seats, API tokens, model tier, and enterprise support levels.","discussion_point":"Negotiate usage caps, committed-use discounts, renewal protections, and clear model-tier pricing."},"ai_cloud_integration":{"summary":"OpenAI workloads often integrate through direct APIs or Microsoft Azure deployment paths.","discussion_point":"Clarify preferred deployment architecture, latency expectations, and data residency requirements."},"product_roadmap":{"summary":"Roadmap focus includes multimodal models, agents, workflow automation, and enterprise controls.","discussion_point":"Request roadmap visibility for model retirement, context windows, governance, and admin capabilities."},"security_compliance":{"context":"Enterprise adoption requires strong data retention, privacy, audit, and access-control terms.","discussion_point":"Confirm no-training commitments, retention windows, audit logs, and incident response obligations."},"partnership_opportunities":{"context":"OpenAI can support strategic productivity pilots across support, engineering, finance, and knowledge work.","discussion_point":"Identify two high-volume workflows for a controlled pilot with measurable ROI and usage governance."}}
